content.title: About
content.content: Roll is a ready‑to‑eat product made from whole wheat grains enriched with NS bran. It has a light crunchy texture, a mild nutty flavor, and is suitable for breakfast or as a snack.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: NS bran (non‑starch by‑product) contains more than 70 % dietary fiber.
Roll is produced without artificial colors or flavorings.
The product has a low glycemic index, making it suitable for blood‑sugar management.
NS bran is rich in B‑vitamins and minerals such as iron and magnesium.
Roll is packaged in single‑serve portions for easy storage and transport.

items.title: Rich in dietary fiber
items.content: NS bran provides a high amount of soluble and insoluble fiber, supporting normal digestion.

items.title: Supports cardiovascular health
items.content: Fiber helps lower LDL‑cholesterol levels in the blood.

items.title: Source of B‑vitamins
items.content: Vitamins B1, B2, B3 and folate contribute to energy metabolism and nervous system function.

items.title: Mineral complex
items.content: Iron, magnesium and zinc in the bran are important for blood formation and muscle function.

items.title: Low calorie
items.content: Roll contains fewer calories than traditional bakery products, useful for weight control.

items.title: Wheat allergy
items.content: The product may trigger allergic reactions in individuals sensitive to gluten.

items.title: High fiber content
items.content: Large portions can cause gastrointestinal discomfort in people unaccustomed to high fiber intake.

items.title: Phytic acid presence
items.content: Bran contains phytates, which may reduce the absorption of certain minerals when consumed in excess.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Roll can be eaten as a standalone snack, added to yogurt, kefir, salads, or used as a base for quick sandwiches. If desired, briefly warm the roll in a microwave to enhance its aroma.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store roll in a dry, cool place, tightly sealed. For long‑term storage, keep the product in the refrigerator to maintain crispness and prevent mold growth.
